description: In a well-order of uncountable cofinality, intersecting a stationary set with a club leaves a stationary set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.stationary_inter_club.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  (hα : Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof α) {S C : Set α} (hS : IsStationary S) (hC : IsClub C) : IsStationary (S ∩ C)
